proof_summary: Track the tail masses via the averaging recurrence \(F(n,t+1,i+1)=\lfloor(F(n,t,i)+F(n,t,i+1))/2\rfloor\); conservation and positivity show that stability is equivalent to positivity of the last relevant tail, and an induction also gives stabilization by time \(2(n-1)\). Shift comparisons show that positivity for mass \(n\) at time \(t\) implies positivity for mass \(n+1\) at time \(t+2\), while positivity for mass \(n+1\) at time \(t+1\) forces it for mass \(n\) at time \(t\), sandwiching the two minimal stabilization times one or two steps apart.
